fusions.name: Mailed Jab
fusions.desc: A gauntleted jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gauntlet Thrown Down
fusions.desc: Throws your gauntlet at one enemy for 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Vambrace Parry
fusions.desc: Raises your forearm as a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Riveted Mitts
fusions.desc: Conjures riveted gauntlets: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, you attack 4% faster, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
